name: run-deck
description: Turns the commands Claude asks you to run into numbered buttons above the prompt: press a digit to run one, see the exit code, and the output rides back to Claude with your next prompt.

confirm.title: Confirm before running
confirm.description: Which commands need a second press before they run: risky ones (rm -r, git push, sudo, prod...), all of them, or none

output.title: Output pane
output.description: on-demand: the pane opens when you press a finished row (or on a failure, with on_error show); always: it opens while every command runs

on_error.title: When a command fails
on_error.description: fix: send the output to Claude right away to fix; show: open the output pane; wait: mark the row and send the result with your next prompt

copy.title: Copy the block to the clipboard
copy.description: Also put the whole command block on the clipboard when a reply ends with one

auto_continue.title: Continue automatically
auto_continue.description: Send the results to Claude as soon as every command has run, instead of waiting for your next prompt

background.title: Band background
background.description: A color for the band and the output pane, a hex like #11111b or a theme name; empty keeps the terminal's

suggest_clear.title: Suggest /clear
suggest_clear.description: When a turn ends with nothing left to run and the context is at least this full (percent), the deck offers /clear as its last row; 0 turns it off
